GHA.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Only a count of 382 persons with disabilities registered; no accessible service or rule stated.

facts.fact: The Electoral Commission's Deputy Commissioner says the 2024 limited registration ran at 268 district offices on an online registration system that prevents double registration, with 251,149 voters registered by day six.
The Electoral Commission says applicants identify themselves with the Ghana Card, used by 98,926 registrants (39.39%) in the first days, and it wants the guarantor system abolished.

GHA.note: No national ID enrolment count or share; only voter registration figures.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs the ID system.
Ghana Card is accepted as proof when registering; the document does not say the roll is keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The Electoral Commission says the Ghana Card, which carries date of birth and nationality, was used as identification by 98,926 registrants in the 2024 exercise.
